name: frostwolf
description: Cloak personal data and secrets before Claude sees them, and block prompt injection, in every Claude Code session.

api_key.title: FrostWolf API key
api_key.description: Your FrostWolf API key, from https://frostwolf.app. Stored in your system's secure credential store.

endpoint.title: API endpoint
endpoint.description: FrostWolf API base URL. Leave empty for https://api.frostwolf.app.

prompt_personal_data.title: Personal data in prompts
prompt_personal_data.description: block refuses a prompt that carries personal data and offers a cloaked version to send instead. warn sends it as typed and tells you.

on_unavailable.title: When FrostWolf is unreachable
on_unavailable.description: block refuses prompts, tool calls, and tool output FrostWolf could not check. allow lets them through unchecked.

display.title: Terminal display
display.description: restore shows real values where Claude wrote tokens. tokens shows the tokens, as Claude sees them.
